hook.name: WooPPV2Aggregator v1.0
hook.description: Aggregator hook that fills Uniswap v4 swaps directly from WOOFi's WooPPV2 oracle-priced market maker, returning a BeforeSwapDelta so the v4 pool itself holds no liquidity. Liquidity provision on the v4 pool is disabled, the hook is immutable and ownerless, and a protocol fee capped by a constant is taken on each swap. Swaps revert when WooPPV2 reserves cannot cover them. WooPPV2 is an upgradeable proxy.
